name: footer-pulse-links
title: Footer Pulse Links
description: A dark site footer where every link label rolls up letter by letter into lime on hover while a heartbeat line draws itself in underneath, closed by a wordmark fitted to the column whose letters rise in and then lift and tilt toward the pointer.
docs:
Docs, props and examples: https://tween-ui.vercel.app/block/footer-pulse-links
GSAP plugins (ScrollTrigger) are registered inside the component, so there is nothing to set up.
Pass your own `columns`, `socials` and `legal` links; the link hover is plain CSS and only the wordmark uses GSAP.
